name: Gitignore Generator
summary: Build a .gitignore from common stacks — Node, Next.js, Python, OS, and more.
description: Toggle stack templates (macOS, Windows, Node, Next.js, Python, VS Code, JetBrains, env secrets, logs) and copy a combined .gitignore. Everything runs locally.

faqs.question: Are these official GitHub templates?
faqs.answer: They are curated common patterns for Forge’s MVP. You can edit the output before committing.

faqs.question: Can I select multiple stacks?
faqs.answer: Yes. Selected sections are concatenated in a stable order.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
